description: ArcGIS export of the Huron River watershed used as the basemap of Figure 2a, and its georeference. Pixel coordinates of a (lon, lat) point: px = (p0*lon + p1)*s - ox + 100, py = (p2*mercator(lat) + p3)*s - oy + 100, with mercator(lat) = ln(tan(pi/4 + lat/2)); fitted by registering the image to the river centerlines.
attribution: Basemap: Esri, NASA, NGA, USGS, TomTom, Garmin, FAO, NOAA, OpenStreetMap contributors, GIS User Community
